Tesla Model Y is the best-selling car of any kind on Earth

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: DogeDesigner (@cb_doge); megjelent: 2026-11-06T10:06:44+00:00; link: https://x.com/cb_doge/status/2118646253865320741; média: videó, 15 másodperc]
Tesla Model Y is Australia’s best-selling passenger vehicle so far this year, beating the Toyota RAV4.

From January through October, Tesla sold 39,035 Model Ys versus 35,927 RAV4s. Sales of Tesla’s all-electric SUV jumped 117.2% compared with the same period last year.
